name: Doctor Strange

skins.name: Sinister
skins.lore: The Sinister skin represents Sinister Strange, the corrupted Doctor Strange from Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness who became consumed by dark magic and forbidden spells.

skins.name: Defender
skins.lore: The Defender skin represents Defender Strange from the beginning of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, where he protects America Chavez while fleeing through the multiverse.

skins.name: Wong
skins.lore: The Wong skin references Wong from Marvel, Doctor Strange's closest ally and the Sorcerer Supreme who protects Earth using powerful mystic arts and dimensional magic.

skins.name: Zombie
skins.lore: The Zombie skin represents the corpse of Defender Strange after the original Doctor Strange possesses and controls his dead body using forbidden dreamwalking magic in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

lore: Doctor Strange is a master sorcerer from Marvel Comics and the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Once a brilliant neurosurgeon, Stephen Strange became the Sorcerer Supreme after studying the mystic arts, gaining access to powerful spells, dimensional magic, portals, and time manipulation abilities.
